endorsements.name: Harrison Sand
endorsements.label: So Long, and Thanks for All the Phish
endorsements.description: A rare look behind the scenes of a global phishing-as-a-service operation. We tell the story of how we infiltrated a phishing group, cracked their software, exploited a hidden backdoor, and followed an OSINT rabbit hole to uncover the identify of the primary software developer.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 33

evidence-links.title: DEF CON 33 - So Long, and Thanks for All the Phish - Harrison Sand, Erlend Leiknes

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
